language: Crimson Ki motes are the universal hit language; phase colours appear only on fighter kits and phase effects. Every area effect draws its edge clearly, because the radius is the counterplay.
routes: Planned route: harvest free Creator Store VFX packs you own into your roblox-vfx library, then search it with each effect's 'from' words and recolour to the palette. The library is empty today, so section 4 starts by harvesting a pack. Pre-authorised fallback: Tidebell's VfxController approach (Parts, Beams and ParticleEmitters with built-in textures, built in code).
